comment: Copy to config/local.json (ignored by Git) to change this machine's paths; every key is optional and '~' is expanded. Environment variables win over this file: G1_STUDENT_DEPLOY, LUCID_DEPLOY_ROOT, STUDIO_DATA, FLOW_ROOT (studio/paths.py). 'sessions' adds this machine's own recordings, with the same entries as config/sessions.json. docs/INSTALL.md.
